decision_question: Did the pilot stay inside the approved devices, tenants, users, dates, and actions?
required_evidence: Approved pilot charter; actual target inventory; change records
pass_condition: Actual activity reconciles to the authorized boundary
stop_condition: Any unexplained or unauthorized target or action

decision_question: Were all mandatory tests completed or formally dispositioned?
required_evidence: Test register; skipped-test approvals; retest records
pass_condition: Every mandatory test has a pass or approved exception
stop_condition: A mandatory test is missing without an accountable exception

decision_question: Are all triggered stop conditions closed?
required_evidence: Stop-event log; containment evidence; closure approval
pass_condition: No triggered stop condition remains unresolved
stop_condition: A safety, security, isolation, or recovery stop remains open

decision_question: Did representative endpoints behave as required?
required_evidence: Endpoint inventory; OS and site matrix; test results
pass_condition: Supported representative systems passed their acceptance gates
stop_condition: A required platform or operating condition was not tested

decision_question: Were telemetry freshness, alert routing, ownership, and recovery proven?
required_evidence: Timestamped telemetry; alert and ticket records; recovery evidence
pass_condition: Required signals arrived on time and reached an accountable owner
stop_condition: A critical condition can be missed, delayed, duplicated, or left unowned

decision_question: Were patch state, maintenance windows, failure handling, and restart behavior reconciled?
required_evidence: Before-and-after patch state; logs; restart records; exception list
pass_condition: Patch and restart outcomes match policy and remain explainable
stop_condition: Patch state is stale, failures are hidden, or restarts are uncontrolled

decision_question: Were targeting, preview, approval, execution context, cancellation, and failure evidence proven?
required_evidence: Target previews; approvals; job logs; failure and cancellation records
pass_condition: Authorized automation affects only intended systems and leaves usable evidence
stop_condition: Target scope is ambiguous or failed work cannot be stopped or reconstructed

decision_question: Were authorization, session visibility, termination, revocation, and audit records proven?
required_evidence: Session approvals; audit logs; revocation test; technician identity
pass_condition: Every session is attributable, bounded, terminable, and reviewable
stop_condition: Access persists after revocation or a session cannot be attributed

decision_question: Did role, tenant, credential, and cross-customer boundaries hold?
required_evidence: Role tests; cross-tenant negative tests; credential review; audit records
pass_condition: Least-privilege users cannot reach out-of-scope customers or secrets
stop_condition: Any cross-tenant access or uncontrolled privileged path exists

decision_question: Can the team reconstruct important actions and export required records?
required_evidence: Audit exports; timestamps; actor and target IDs; retention test
pass_condition: Required events are complete, attributable, exportable, and retained
stop_condition: Material actions lack actor, target, time, result, or exportable evidence

decision_question: Is daily technician effort acceptable without hidden vendor dependence?
required_evidence: Time log; escalation log; support responses; unresolved defects
pass_condition: Routine work fits the staffing model and critical issues have an owned path
stop_condition: The service depends on unsustainable manual work or unresolved support blockers

decision_question: Are price, term, minimums, add-ons, retained tools, and exit costs understood?
required_evidence: Dated quote; contract terms; tool-retirement list; total-cost worksheet
pass_condition: The approved cost model includes required capabilities and transition costs
stop_condition: Material price or contract terms remain unknown

decision_question: Were agent removal, access revocation, queued-work cancellation, and record reconciliation proven?
required_evidence: Uninstall evidence; credential revocation; queue and console reconciliation
pass_condition: The pilot can end without residual access, unmanaged work, or orphaned records
stop_condition: The tool or privileged path cannot be removed safely

decision_question: Does every residual risk have an owner, deadline, compensating control, and retest rule?
required_evidence: Exception register; risk acceptance; remediation plan; retest date
pass_condition: Every exception is time-bounded and accountable
stop_condition: A material risk has no owner, due date, control, or decision authority

decision_question: Did named technical and business approvers record one explicit outcome?
required_evidence: Completed gate register; signed decision record; rollout or exit plan
pass_condition: Decision is Go, Limited go, Remediate and retest, or No-go with named next actions
stop_condition: No accountable approver accepts the residual risk and next step
